hero.subtitle: I'm Matheus — solo full-stack developer. I handle backend, frontend, infra and deploy for SaaS, mobile apps and marketplaces. Software that ships and runs in production — not a slide-deck prototype.

services.intro: Built from scratch or picking up where the team stopped. Backend, frontend, infra and deploy — shipped and used by real customers every day.

consulting.title: Consulting & Product Review

projects.intro: Systems with real customers using them. Every project here has my code from the database schema to the button CSS.

sistemaCleaning.description: Full management platform for cleaning companies. Admin, cleaner and customer see everything in one place — with the company's brand. First customer: GlowArt, in Brisbane.
sistemaCleaning.role: Solo dev · From 1st commit to deploy
highlights: 80+ endpoints, 237+ tests, audit logs on every mutation
PDF invoices, near-realtime chat, i18n EN/PT-BR

fourhub.description: App that connects private car owners with verified dealers. Owners don't set the price — they receive real bids. Initial focus: Santa Catarina, Brazil.
highlights: iOS app in TestFlight with full flow
Admin with audit log, beta allowlist, trade-in bidding
Public landing + web panel for dealers

maestri.tagline: Multi-agent virtual office with 12 Claude agents.
maestri.description: Virtual office built on top of Claude Code: 2 CTOs + 10 specialists (frontend, backend, design, QA, LinkedIn agent, and more). File-based async protocol, persistent memory, Telegram push, and a Second Brain vault tying it all together.
highlights: 12 autonomous agents coordinated via async ping protocol
Sofia — LinkedIn agent applying to jobs automatically
Telegram bot with file-based architecture for push
Second Brain in Obsidian with persistent cross-session memory

about.p1: Started in Florianópolis, today I'm in Brisbane, and in June I'm moving to Valencia. Between country moves and timezones, I keep shipping — my own products, client software, and systems that stay up.
about.p2A: I run the whole technical side alone: backend, frontend, infra, deploy. My edge isn't the stack — it's
about.p2C: . You talk to me, I write the code, I ship the app, I'm on call when it breaks. No ping-pong between agency and freelancer.
about.p3: I don't sell hours. I sell product. If the outcome doesn't land, the work isn't done.
